The CLI parsing and dispatching is implemented across **4 files** in `src/code_scout/`:

<final_answer>
- src/code_scout/cli.py (lines 1-455) — Main CLI entry point.
- src/code_scout/commands/specs.py (lines 1-187) — Command definitions and lookup.
- src/code_scout/commands/parser.py (lines 1-167) — Parses CLI arguments.
- src/code_scout/commands/dispatch.py (lines 1-271) — Dispatches commands.
</final_answer>
